text:
release-manager: heads-up — hotfix needs to land before tonight's cutover (20:00 PST). Need a 2nd-eye / second approval by 19:20 or we fallback to revert plan. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1299. Brief: lower quant stash eviction threshold to avoid a mem leak under long tails. Small change but touches the memory ops path.

maya: taking a look now, can someone confirm a quick smoke on staging?

sam: ran a 10m qps smoke on staging-1, no OOMs observed. logs: `runtime: evict_count=0`, latency within baseline.

juan: skimmed diff, left a comment about an assert in stash.c — looks like we should handle an edge case. I can give LGTM after that's addressed. ping me @juan when patched.

olivia: CI: curl-integration is flaky, saw a test_timeout in job 4821. I'm rerunning the job now.

sre-bot: Deploy rule check: approvals required met = 1/2. Deploy scheduled if 2/2 by cutoff. deploy-id=dpl_202611.

maya: pushed fix for the assert in branch `fix/assert-handling`, rebased onto release branch. If anyone needs to cherry-pick locally:
```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout release-2026-03
git cherry-pick -x abc1234
```

juan: re-reviewed after patch — LGTM. :+1:

maya: LGTM from me as well :thumbsup:

release-manager: excellent — we have 2 approvals. I'll merge and kick off the canary run at 20:00 PST. If canary fails we will rollback to `release-2026-03` and reopen the PR. Thanks for the quick turnaround everyone!
